packageRules.description: The MSRV is a compatibility promise, not a dependency: `rust-version` in Cargo.toml, the MSRV badge rendered into the README and the `msrv` CI job all move together, as a decision.
`fuzz/` is a separate workspace whose lockfile only ever backs a local fuzzing run. Bumps there are grouped so they cost one pull request rather than one per crate.
